dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,9)>Drif driiifff... Oh, hi... Nice to meet you. Are you, uh, out
for a stroll?
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>You know, I really like a nice stroll too.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>I bet it’d be lots of fun if we, um, traveled together...
don’t you think?

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Y’know, I really like it here... It’s so nice! But, uhhh...
I guess I don’t have anywhere to live, huh?

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>It’d be real nice if I could have, like...a nice, chill home
where I could just hang out, y’know?

<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>Huh? You’re gonna make a home for me? Oh wow, that’s
so cool! <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>Thank you so much, I’m looking forward to it!

<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>Huh? You’re gonna make a home for me? Oh wow, that’s
so cool! <$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>Thank you so much, I’m looking forward to it!

<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)>Oooh, but I have a, y’know, request?
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>It’d be super cool if I could live close to everyone. I bet
then I’d never be lonely!
<$voicel(1,8)>Thanks again, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>!

<$voicel(1,7)>It’d be so, sooo cool if my home were close to where
everyone else lives...
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)>You made me a home? Yayyy! Thank you! ♪
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,21)>I hope we can keep being, y’know, really good friends!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Oh, hi there, <$cdef(27)>! Thanks for
making
me
a home.
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>I kinda wanted to take you someplace special as, y’know,
my way of showing appreciation, but...
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Uhhh... There aren’t many humans around here, are there?

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>So like... Humans give me energy, you know? Human kids
in particular give me lots!
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,31)>Without them, I dunno... I really just don’t feel like doing
anything at all...

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,8)><$facial(1,4)>Awww, thank you! You’re so understanding,
<$cdef(27)>!
I really wish I could, y’know, pull myself out of this rut...

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)>Wow, you’re pretty, y’know, gung-ho about things, aren’t
you? That perked me up a little bit—thanks!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>You know, even if humans aren’t around... I bet I could get
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)>a kick of energy from, y’know, <$cdef(27)>dolls that humans were
really attached to.

<$voicel(1,5)>Now that I think about it... I’m getting <$cdef(27)>doll vibes from over
that way. So uhhh... Yeah. Maybe check it out?

<$voicel(1,8)>So, y’know, if you do find a <$cdef(27)>doll, you should come show it
to me, OK?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>A <$cdef(27)>doll </color>will perk me up, I bet. Yeah. That’s all I need.

<$voicel(1,6)>You know, I’m picking up on like...<$cdef(27)>doll vibes? They’re
coming from over that way.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>Oh yay! You found a <$cdef(27)>doll</color>! Hee hee, it’s so cute... ♪

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,14)>I bet someone really loved this... I can feel all the
memories it has stored up inside...
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>Hee hee hee hee... Floohoo hoo hoo... ♪

<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Wheee! Yeah, that gave me all the energy I needed. Thank
you so much, <$cdef(27)>!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)>How about I take you somewhere amazing right now?
Come on, let’s go together!

If you show <$cdef(27)>Drifloon a <$cdef(27)>doll, they can take you to a
<$cdef(27)>Dream Island!

<$cdef(27)>Dream Islands are rather mysterious worlds of their own.
You can collect a variety of things there.
Exactly what you can find will change dramatically
depending on what sort of <$cdef(27)>doll you show to <$cdef(27)>Drifloon.

But you can only go to one of these places per day.
If you’d like to go to another <$cdef(27)>Dream Island, try asking
<$cdef(27)>Drifloon tomorrow!
